mapper.insert: INSERT INTO replyBoard(writer, email, subject, password, ref, re_step, re_level, content, upload1, upload2) VALUES(#{writer}, #{email}, #{subject}, #{password}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(r.ref) + 1, 1) FROM replyBoard r), 1, 1, #{content}, #{upload1}, #{upload2})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM replyBoard ORDER BY ref DESC, re_step ASC
